description: This file defines the class "LegacyCommandClientImpl", which is a client implementation for Hono's Command & Control API (legacy endpoint) using Vert.x and Proton for AMQP messaging. It includes methods for creating, sending commands (both request-response and one-way), and managing links for communication with devices within a multi-tenant environment. The class extends AbstractRequestResponseClient and implements LegacyCommandClient, and contains logic for generating message IDs, handling request/response flow, and integrating tracing.

classes.name: LegacyCommandClientImpl
classes.description: A Vert.x-based client implementation for Hono's legacy Command & Control API endpoint, providing methods to send commands and manage links with AMQP messaging.

methods.name: LegacyCommandClientImpl
methods.description: Constructors initializing the client instance with connection info and optional AMQP links.

methods.name: getTargetAddress
methods.description: Returns the target AMQP address for sending commands to a specific device within a tenant.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the endpoint name identifier for this client, i.e., "control".

methods.name: createMessageId
methods.description: Generates a unique message ID based on an internal counter, for correlating requests and responses.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Creates and returns a BufferResult object encapsulating the status, content-type, payload, and application properties.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command with optional content type and properties, returning a future with the BufferResult response.

methods.name: sendOneWayCommand
methods.description: Sends a one-way command without expecting a response.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to instantiate and initialize a LegacyCommandClient for a specific device, setting up AMQP links.
